entries.english:
Matters concerning linen weavers and cloth makers.

Terms: 1597, 1636, 1651, 1686–1694, 1706–1732.

Includes, among other things: (1) regulations for linen weavers in the territory of the lords von Rosenberg (copy), 1597; (2) the same for the Haltenbergstetten district, 1636; (3) disputes between linen weaver Christoph Denner of Rinderfeld, on one side, and Hans Schirnig and his stepson Hans Himmelein, both of Wildentierbach, on the other, 1686; (4) admission of cloth maker Hans Lihr of Niederstetten to the Weikersheim cloth makers' guild, 1709; (5) master status for weaver Hans Markert of Laudenbach, 1724; (6) release of a weaver Hans Georg Keittel's apprentice at Gerabronn, 1724.

Extent: 1 file.
